Heute or Morgen? German A1 Day-Word Exercises

Practise heute and morgen for today and tomorrow in German. Distinguish morgen from der Morgen with translated models and explained A1 answers.

A1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the difference

Heute means today and morgen means tomorrow. As adverbs they are normally lowercase within a sentence. Der Morgen means the morning and is a capitalised noun; am Morgen means in the morning. Morgen can therefore mean tomorrow or be a noun, depending on the structure.

Common mistake to avoid

Morgen früh means tomorrow morning. Do not confuse the time adverb morgen with the noun in am Morgen.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Compare the meaning and sentence pattern, rather than choosing by English translation alone.

Worked example 1Heute ist unser erster Kurstag.Today is our first day of the course.
Worked example 2Wir fahren morgen früh nach Jena.We are travelling to Jena early tomorrow.
Worked example 3Ich habe heute Nachmittag frei.I am free this afternoon.
Worked example 4Das Paket kommt erst morgen.The parcel will not arrive until tomorrow.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose heute or morgen from the stated day relationship. Use the adverb, not the noun der Morgen. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Es ist gerade Montag; ___ ist Dienstag. (tomorrow)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: morgen

Morgen refers to the day after the current Monday.

Question 2. Das Konzert findet an diesem Tag statt, also ___. (today)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: heute

Heute means on the current day.

Question 3. Ich erledige es am nächsten Tag, also ___. (tomorrow)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: morgen

Morgen is the adverb for the next day.

Question 4. Nicht gestern und nicht morgen: Wir treffen uns ___. (today)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: heute

Heute identifies the current day.

Use it in your own sentence

Contrast studying today with working tomorrow.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Heute lerne ich, und morgen arbeite ich.

Check your wording: Heute is the current day; morgen is the following day in this use.

What to practise next

Write a new context for each word. Explain which meaning or object pattern makes your choice natural; some contexts allow both.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
